channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kelly Oubre | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kelly Oubre from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Kelly Oubre
item.description:
Daryl Morey on Kelly Oubre's return:

“Kelly was one of our most important contributors last season, bringing physicality, energy, and toughness to the table on a nightly basis. We’re excited to have him back and believe he’ll play a key role in our pursuit of a championship.”

Daryl Morey on Kelly Oubre, Jul 7, 2024. Source: Twitter @LaurenMRosen.

item.title: Lou Williams on Draymond Green, Kelly Oubre
item.description:
“So Kelly Oubre doesn't have a history of this type of thing right? If this is Draymond Green, the world blows up today... This is $25,000 per b*tch without a doubt.”

Lou Williams on Draymond Green, Kelly Oubre, Mar 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Tyrese Maxey on Kelly Oubre
item.description:
However, he didn't want to focus on himself after the game.

“This had nothing to do with me. It's all Kelly Oubre, man. We're praying for him. I love my dawg. I just met him, but I love him. I hope he gets well soon,”

Tyrese Maxey on Kelly Oubre, Nov 13, 2023. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Kelly Oubre
item.description:
Nick Nurse on what Kelly Oubre means to this @sixers team:

“He comes in, practices hard, plays hard, is a likable personality. A lot of the guys reached out immediately. I talked to Kelly earlier this afternoon, & he said the amount of love he got from the team was awesome.”

Nick Nurse on Kelly Oubre, Nov 12, 2023. Source: Twitter @LaurenMRosen.

item.title: Tristan Thompson on Bojan Bogdanovic, Kelly Oubre
item.description:
“Our bench was deeper than theirs. We had [Bojan Bogdanovic], Kelly Oubre, you know what I mean?”

Tristan Thompson on Bojan Bogdanovic, Kelly Oubre, Jan 19, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Kelly Oubre
item.description:
Lillard told The Athletic.

“I liked Oubre as a complement to other guys I thought we would be able to get. We didn’t get them.”

Damian Lillard on Kelly Oubre, Aug 8, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Kelly Oubre
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Steve Kerr on Kelly Oubre's shift to the bench:

“It's not easy for any player to go from starting to the bench... He told me whatever we need to do to win. His attitude has been great... We need him. We need him to perform at a high level, to bring energy.”

Steve Kerr on Kelly Oubre, Apr 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Andrew Bogut on Kelly Oubre, Lonzo Ball
item.description:
He says the Warriors turned down a Lonzo Ball trade from the New Orleans Pelicans centered around Oubre.

“This is an interesting one because I got some word from behind the scenes there.... I have it on good authority they had on offer actually for Lonzo Ball and I think a throw-in pick for Oubre and the Warriors turned it down, funnily enough,”

Andrew Bogut on Kelly Oubre, Lonzo Ball, Apr 6, 2021. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Bob Myers on Kelly Oubre
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Bob Myers:

“We like Kelly (Oubre), and we'd like to be able to see him in our future plans. ... Obviously, it takes two.”

Bob Myers on Kelly Oubre, Mar 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Kelly Oubre
item.description:
Steve Kerr on Kelly Oubre, who could be traded before Thursday's deadline:

“He's coveted, he's naturally coveted. He's done a great job of handling everything. ... We'll see what happens.”

Steve Kerr on Kelly Oubre, Mar 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Kelly Oubre
item.description:
Wes Goldberg:Steve Kerr on Kelly Oubre:

“The slow start for Kelly is more just about a lack of flow with our starting group. And that's something we're trying to address.”

Steve Kerr on Kelly Oubre, Jan 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @wcgoldberg.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Kelly Oubre
item.description:
Drew Shiller:Steve Kerr on Kelly Oubre:

“He is really competitive. I love his energy and his effort, his defensive intensity ... he just cares. He really, really wants to do well and wants to win. I just love coaching him and watching him compete.”

Steve Kerr on Kelly Oubre, Dec 31, 2020. Source: Twitter @DrewShiller.

item.title: Bob Myers on Joe Lacob, Kelly Oubre
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Bob Myers on the Oubre news:

“We’re exploring a lot of different things. I’m not saying this because the guy’s 15 feet away from me, but I am so lucky to have an ownership group like ours...(Joe Lacob) wants to win.”

Bob Myers on Joe Lacob, Kelly Oubre, Nov 19, 2020. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Brandon Ingram on Kelly Oubre
item.description:
He takes a look at drives and sometimes wishes he would have made the extra pass to a teammate on the wing to boost that player's confidence.

“Even that play with Kelly Oubre, I said, 'If I quit on that play, then everybody else quits on that same play.' Somebody else that wasn't me could've blocked that ball,”

Brandon Ingram on Kelly Oubre, Jan 3, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Monty Williams on Kelly Oubre
item.description:
#Suns coachMonty Williams on Kelly Oubre Jr.'s return:

“He was one of the reasons why I was excited about the job... I loved his versatility from afar,being in Philly (as an assistant) and San Antonio (in the front office).”

Monty Williams on Kelly Oubre, Jul 16, 2019. Source: Twitter @ginamizell.

item.title: Igor Kokoskov on Kelly Oubre
item.description:
Gina Mizell:Igor Kokoskov on Kelly Oubre’s thumb injury:

“We feel bad about it. Especially lately, the way he was playing, (he was) a big part of our team,a big part of our offense...he can’t help us on the court, but even that little help on the sideline can be crucial.”

Igor Kokoskov on Kelly Oubre, Mar 21, 2019. Source: Twitter @ginamizell.

item.title: Deandre Ayton on Kelly Oubre
item.description:
Deandre Ayton on Kelly Oubre:

“He has been playing super hard. He is matching the same energy that I have, that we all have. It is beautiful. He fits right in. You can tell he wants to win, and he tries his best on defense.”

Deandre Ayton on Kelly Oubre, Dec 28, 2018. Source: Twitter @AlexKennedyNBA.

item.title: Devin Booker on Kelly Oubre
item.description:
Devin Booker on Kelly Oubre:

“He knows how to play the game. I've known Kelly for a long time. We were in the same draft class, and I really know his game. He knows how to play and he is versatile; he can guard 1 through 4 and he can play 1 through 4 too.”

Devin Booker on Kelly Oubre, Dec 28, 2018. Source: Twitter @AlexKennedyNBA.

item.title: Markieff Morris on Kelly Oubre
item.description:
Fred Katz:Markieff Morris on Kelly Oubre:

“He did almost have the last laugh. I even said, if there had to be somebody hit a game winner, let it be him — or nobody.”

Markieff Morris on Kelly Oubre, Dec 23, 2018. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Igor Kokoskov on Austin Rivers, Kelly Oubre
item.description:
Gina Mizell:#Suns coach Igor Kokoskov on what Kelly Oubre and Austin Rivers will bring:

“We need somebody who’s gonna help us with maintaining. A lot of games, we can’t go through the 48 minutes... We’re gonna find their roles. We definitely can use the talent and experience they have.”

Igor Kokoskov on Austin Rivers, Kelly Oubre, Dec 17, 2018. Source: Twitter @ginamizell.

item.title: John Wall on Kelly Oubre
item.description:
John Wall on Kelly Oubre:

“Especially K.O., being here four years, watching him develop from his rookie year not getting any minutes and coming into his own and being an X-factor for our team the last couple of years, it's sad to see him go.”

John Wall on Kelly Oubre, Dec 15, 2018. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Delon Wright on Kelly Oubre
item.description:
Delon Wright on Oubre's comments to @Candace Buckner suggesting he only plays well at home:

“I saw it. I mean, that's his opinion. I didn't play as good as I did at home there, but he made it seem like I was just a total bust. We'll see in Game 6.”

Delon Wright on Kelly Oubre, Apr 26, 2018. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Isaiah Thomas on Kelly Oubre
item.description:
Chris Forsberg:Isaiah Thomas on Kelly Oubre:

“He should be suspended. If you do that, that should be automatic. So we're not really worried about him.”

Isaiah Thomas on Kelly Oubre, May 6, 2017. Source: Twitter @ESPNForsberg.

item.title: Isaiah Thomas on Kelly Olynyk, Kelly Oubre
item.description:
Jay King:Isaiah Thomas on Oubre-Olynyk:

“They know who to go at. The whole NBA knows certain players they can targetand certain players they can't.”

Isaiah Thomas on Kelly Olynyk, Kelly Oubre, May 6, 2017. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Kelly Olynyk on Kelly Oubre
item.description:
Olynyk on Oubre:

“Idon't really know him that well. I thought he was a good guy.”

Kelly Olynyk on Kelly Oubre, May 6, 2017. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Kelly Oubre
item.description:
Adam Himmelsbach:Brooks on Oubre:

“I don't think he should have reacted the way he did but I also understand why he reacted the way he did.”

Scott Brooks on Kelly Oubre, May 5, 2017. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: Ted Leonsis on Kelly Oubre
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:Ted Leonsis on Kelly Oubre:

“Every player noted to me he's very hard to play against. The players wanted him to play more.”

Ted Leonsis on Kelly Oubre, Apr 27, 2016. Source: Twitter @JMichaelCSN.
